title: Unit Event — Rekindle the Flame — Episode6 A Song to Shake the Heart

meta.Episode: Episode6 — A Song to Shake the Heart
meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next goal is to stand on top of the world. As each member strives to better themselves, something seems to be eating at Akito...

rows.Line: The next day - Early morning

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You began dreaming of surpassing RAD WEEKEND after just happening to come across it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, you might find something else that rekindles the flame inside of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The world...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (To be honest, I still don't have a good idea of what the world out there looks like.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But if there is something that can make me feel that way again, then...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is somebody singing...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I think it's coming from the park we always use...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But it doesn't sound like Toya or the others...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And these voices...)
se_run_men_001_1
se_run_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Who are they...?
I don't recognize them.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(What the...?!
He's doing that without even breaking a sweat...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like every note and lyric is piercing my chest...!)
“Man, there really is nothing better than singing first thing in the morning!”
“I get that, but keep it down... We need to make sure we don't wake up the neighborhood...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They're speaking English... I don't know what they're saying. Are they talking about singing...?)
“Sorry, but I really felt like singing after taking a stroll through Vivid Street.”
“Wait... Huh?!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (H-Huh? They just saw me and froze...)
H-Hey, you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...?!
They can speak Japanese? Pretty well too...
Aren't you from Vivid BAD SQUAD?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

I knew it!
You sang at RAD BLAST, right?!
Wow, this is so cool! I didn't actually think we'd run into you today! Now I'm really glad we decided to make this our last stop since we're scheduled to fly home today!
Oh, also... Can we shake hands?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: S-Sure...
Hey, where are your manners? You should at least introduce yourself first...

Oh right, sorry!
I'm just so excited is all...

Honestly...
Sorry if he startled you in any way.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: But my name is Cedric. This is my little brother, Slade.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Actually, we're twins! But I'm a few minutes younger, which makes me technically the little brother!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Anyway, what's your name?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Akito Shinonome from Vivid BAD SQUAD...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Your name's Akito?! Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Who are these guys? Do they usually sing somewhere else? But they seem way too good to be just—)

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: We flew all the way from the US to see RAD BLAST.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From the states...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(They came all this way...?
Why? Do they know Taiga or something...?)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
It was such a long flight. Like fourteen hours...
But I'm really glad that we decided to come see it!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
It was such an intense event!
The audience and performers all came together, and there was this absolutely incredible atmosphere...!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Especially when Vivid BAD SQUAD performed!
You guys totally sent shivers down my spine...!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd been so long since someone's singing made us feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: And we really felt like singing after hearing you guys' performance.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: So, on top of sightseeing, we decided to enter into events at live houses where you guys performed!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: And we had so much fun! The audience really brought the energy every time! Right, Ceddy?!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: So, the other day, these mysterious twin brothers showed up out of nowhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're all places we performed at while training, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They were talking about you two...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Huh? Who's they?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Everyone's been talking about you guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Rumors have been flying around about these mysterious twins who appear out of nowhere, put on a ridiculously good performance, then vanish into thin air.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
What?!
People are talking about us?!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: We had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
“How cool is that?!
Mysterious twins who show up, sing and vanish...! We're like superheroes!”

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
“Or really suspicious people...
I know we were short on time, but I feel like we should've at least greeted and thanked everyone properly.”

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: “By the way, you got so worked up you switched to English.”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “Oh, you're right!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Seriously, who are these guys...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (More to the point, how did they know which live houses we performed at...?)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
So, Akito...
I wanna ask you for a small favor.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Can you battle with me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Wait, Slade, you shouldn't ask him to do that. It's early in the morning, and you literally just met him...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Also, if we don't get going soon, we're going to miss our plane.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know.
This is a really sudden request, and we don't really have much time.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: But... I wanna battle against you.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: I've been wanting to do this ever since I watched you guys blow the roof off the place at RAD BLAST!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: And us meeting can't be just a mere coincidence! Please...! As a parting souvenir!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I accept your challenge...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks so much!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Are you sure about this?
You don't have to do this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
This should be better training than just warming up on my own.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And the way he sang...)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Alright! Then, let's start getting ready!
I'm sure you still need to warm up, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Oh, also... This is a serious battle, so no holding back!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You got it.
